name: Kaida Nova

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Kaida Nova
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Kaida carries a celestial blade that chooses its wielder, and it chose her the night her village burned. She crosses the Ashen Reaches searching for the ronin who abandoned her — and the truth about why the sky itself seems to be dimming.

name: Ryo Ashen

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Ryo Ashen
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Once Kaida's closest friend, Ryo trained under the same fallen master and now serves the empire hunting blade-bearers. Every duel between them is as much an argument as a fight.

name: Mei Lantern

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Mei Lantern
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Mei builds the gliders, wards, and lantern-drones that keep the group alive between battles. She talks faster than she fights, and she is rarely wrong about either.

name: Ozren Vale

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Ozren Vale
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: A former imperial blade-master who broke his oath rather than burn one more village, Ozren now teaches Kaida the forms the empire tried to erase.

name: Suzu Windrift

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Suzu Windrift
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Suzu maps the Ashen Reaches by ear, collecting rumors, songs, and shortcuts in equal measure, and insists every road has a story worth trading for.

name: Kestrel Rho

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Kestrel Rho
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Kestrel leads the last independent strike team operating inside the Ashfall exclusion zone, running missions the official Protocol won't authorize.

name: Juno Marchetti

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Juno Marchetti
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Juno never met a locked door — or a collapsing structure — she did not like. Her chaotic energy in the field hides a near-perfect memory for blueprints.

name: Talon Vex

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Talon Vex
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: A former Protocol marksman who went rogue after a mission he still won't discuss, Talon says little and sees everything from half a klick out.

name: ARIA-9

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing ARIA-9
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Salvaged from a downed Protocol dropship, ARIA-9 was built to coordinate airstrikes. Instead it coordinates Kestrel's squad — and keeps its own counsel about why.

name: Sgt. Dax Okafor

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Sgt. Dax Okafor
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Dax carries more armor plating than anyone should be able to move in, and somehow still reaches the extraction point first. The squad's steadiest hand under fire.

name: Det. Lena Cross

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Det. Lena Cross
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Cross has worked every unsolved case that crosses the Meridian city line at midnight, and the Meridian case is the only one she's never closed.

name: Julian Moreau

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Julian Moreau
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Moreau's club sits at the center of every rumor in the city, which is exactly how he likes it. Whether he's an ally or a suspect changes with the lighting.

name: Vivian Sharpe

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Vivian Sharpe
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Sharpe has been three days ahead of the police on every Meridian story so far, and she's not planning to slow down to explain how.

name: Nico Delacroix

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Nico Delacroix
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Nico reads a crime scene like other people read a room, and is the only one on the team who still believes the case is solvable by the book.

name: Insp. Wren Halloway

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Insp. Wren Halloway
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Halloway wants the Meridian case closed for reasons that have nothing to do with justice, and everything to do with who keeps calling him at 2 a.m.

name: Dr. Elena Marsh

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Dr. Elena Marsh
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Marsh discovered the Glass Archive's first recovered fragment and has spent three seasons proving it isn't a hoax — even as the fragments start proving things about her.

name: Curator Abel Finch

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Curator Abel Finch
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Finch has managed the Archive’s public collection for decades and knows exactly which fragments are never shown to visitors — or explained to Marsh.

name: Iris Kaine

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Iris Kaine
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Iris retrieves fragments from wherever they surface, which is rarely somewhere safe, and trusts the Archive’s mission more than she trusts most of its people.

name: Prof. Tobias Lund

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Prof. Tobias Lund
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Lund is the only person who can partially translate the fragments’ script, a fact that makes him both essential and constantly in danger.

name: Nova Reyes

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Nova Reyes
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Reyes started as an intern filing fragment reports. Now she is the one who leaked what the Archive’s board really knew, and there is no going back to filing.

name: Hana

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Hana
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Hana has led LUNARIS since its earliest predebut days, and fans credit her steady presence for holding the group together through three lineup changes.

name: Soojin

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Soojin
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Soojin choreographs most of LUNARIS's title-track breaks herself, blending traditional dance training with sharp, percussive modern lines.

name: Yuri

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Yuri
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Yuri writes her own verses for nearly every LUNARIS release, and fans comb every comeback for the references hidden in her lyrics.

name: Minji

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Minji
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Minji joined LUNARIS as its youngest member and has grown into one of its strongest live vocalists, known for note-perfect high-energy stages.

name: Dahye

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Dahye
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: The group's youngest member, Dahye balances sharp stage presence with an unfiltered, fan-favorite variety-show personality.

name: Aegis (Marcus Steele)

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Aegis (Marcus Steele)
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Marcus built the Vanguard's signature exo-armor to stop the accident that killed his brother from ever happening to anyone else, and has been failing to retire from the mission ever since.

name: Voltaire (Simone Aubert)

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Voltaire (Simone Aubert)
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Simone can channel raw electrical current through her own body, a gift that cost her the career she trained for and gave her the one she has now.

name: Wraithwing (Devon Cole)

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Wraithwing (Devon Cole)
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Devon's glide-suit lets him cover a city in minutes, which makes him the Vanguard's eyes before anyone else arrives — and often its first line of defense.

name: Terra Prime (Amara Osei)

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Terra Prime (Amara Osei)
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Amara can reshape stone and steel with a thought, a power she has only fully trusted herself to use since joining the Vanguard.

name: The Cartographer (Elliot Graves)

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing The Cartographer (Elliot Graves)
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Graves maps the fault lines in every hero team he studies, and has spent years mapping the Vanguard's. He doesn't fight his enemies; he redirects them.

name: Yui Kurogane

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Yui Kurogane
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Yui inherited her family’s duty to bind wandering spirits to paper talismans — and one particular spirit that refuses to stay bound to hers.

name: Shiro Tsukimori

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Shiro Tsukimori
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Shiro trades favors between the living and the dead for a living, and always seems to know more about Yui’s bound spirit than he admits.

name: Renji Amakawa

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Renji Amakawa
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Renji grew up next door to Yui’s family shrine and has spent years pretending not to notice the paper talismans multiplying in her sleeves.

name: Hono Saeki

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Hono Saeki
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Hono comes from a rival exorcist lineage that considers Yui’s family methods reckless, and keeps showing up to prove it whether Yui asks or not.

name: Tsukiko

image.alt: Procedural portrait artwork representing Tsukiko
image.credit: Original procedural SVG, self-authored by the FandomVerse content-generation script (Phase 5) — no external source, no AI image generation.

biography: Tsukiko is the spirit bound to Yui’s oldest talisman, and the only one who remembers why the binding was never supposed to be permanent.
